title: Assessing Applicant's Financial Situation Before Disbursing ComCare Funds
what_it_is: Assessing Applicant's Financial Situation Before Disbursing ComCare Funds

sections.label: Assessing applicant financial situation
sections.summary: MSF obtains information from Government agencies with consent, and applicants furnish documents and self-declarations; renewals require a fresh application and up-to-date declaration.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To assess an applicant's financial situation, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) will, with the applicant's consent, obtain relevant information backend from Government agencies, such as the applicant's employment status, income level and assets owned.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For financial information that is not available from other Government agencies, the applicant is required to furnish the supporting documents and make self-declarations, such as the amount of savings an applicant has in all bank accounts in Singapore and overseas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For clients seeking to renew ComCare assistance, a fresh application must be made and an up-to-date declaration is required.

sections.label: Wrongful ComCare receipt cases
sections.summary: 25 cases of wrongful ComCare receipt from inaccurate bank savings declarations occurred in five years; recovery action is taken and fraudulent cases reported to Police.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Over the last five years, there were a total of 25 cases where clients wrongfully received ComCare due to inaccurate declarations on their bank account savings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Recovery action has been taken in appropriate cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: If it is assessed that the client's actions are fraudulent, MSF will report the case to the Police for investigation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Regardless of whether the case is reported to the Police, we will take steps to recover any erroneous disbursements.

sections.label: SSO officers periodic checks
sections.summary: SSO frontline officers know applicants' financial situations may change and check in periodically, upholding expedience and accountability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Our officers at the frontline, at the SSOs are well aware that, over time, the applicants' financial situation might change and therefore, will check in periodically with each applicant over time; and at the same time, ensuring that the principles of expedience and accountability are upheld.
